description: Room provider webhook handling, reconciliation and access enforcement.

preconditions: Meeting with an active room session; LiveKit is configured.
A participant was just removed from the roster (or a guest invitation just revoked).
cases.return: That meeting's room is reconciled at once: whoever lost access is taken out now instead of at the next 30-second run.

preconditions: Meeting with no active room session (a Published meeting, or an empty room).
cases.return: Nothing happens; with nobody known to be in the room the provider is not called.

preconditions: Meeting with an active room session.
cases.return: Returns at once; the provider is never called.
